verdict.rationale: A live probe found an llms.txt at docs.netlify.com that returns HTTP 200 and describes itself as LLM documentation for the platform. The docs also state that a Markdown version of any page is available by appending `.md` to its URL, giving agents machine-readable docs. missing for 10: no independent or community corroboration of agents successfully using these docs, and no evidence of an expanded llms-full.txt-style bundle.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: HTTP 200 at https://docs.netlify.com/llms.txt # LLM documentation for Netlify
Markdown versions of any documentation page are available by appending `.md` to its URL.
